name: TL071
description: Single JFET-input op-amp, the single-channel member of the TL07x family (TL072 dual, TL074 quad) and electrically identical per channel: low noise, high input impedance. The go-to for a one-off audio gain stage, clean boost, or buffer in pedals and synth circuits. Same core as the TL081 but positioned as the low-noise grade.

pins.name: OFFSET NULL
pins.description: offset null (N1). Classic TL071CP DIP exposes it here; TI's current SLOS080W sheet marks pin 1 as NC on the SOIC (D) / PDIP (P) packages

pins.name: OFFSET NULL
pins.description: offset null (N2). Classic TL071CP DIP exposes it here; NC on the SOIC/PDIP packages per SLOS080W

extra.slew rate: 13 V/us (standard grade; the newer TL071H is 20 V/us typ)
extra.supply: +-3.5V to +-18V (6-36V); TI's 2025 SLOS080W widens the family spec to +-2.25 to +-20V (4.5-40V)
extra.Vos: 3mV typ (10mV max) @ Ta=25C, TL071C grade (13mV max full range)
extra.offset null: 10k-100k pot across the two OFFSET NULL pins, wiper to V- (only on packages that expose them)

typical_application: One-off audio gain stage, clean boost, active filter, or virtual-ground buffer. In single-supply pedals bias the inputs to Vcc/2. Add the offset-null pot only if you need to trim DC offset.
gotchas: OFFSET NULL nuance: classic TL071CP DIP-8 has offset null on pins 1 & 5; TI's current SLOS080W sheet marks 1/5/8 as NC on the SOIC (D) / PDIP (P) packages and exposes offset null only on the SO-8 (PS) package. For an ordinary gain stage it is moot, leave 1 & 5 open either way
JFET input does NOT swing to the negative rail; keep inputs a few volts inside the rails
not rail-to-rail output; expect ~1.5V headroom from each rail
single-supply use needs a half-supply (Vcc/2) reference for the inputs
